library(tidyverse) 
install.packages("tidytuesdayR")
outer_space_objects <- readr::read_csv('https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rfordatascience/tidytuesday/master/data/2024/2024-04-23/outer_space_objects.csv')

# Create table of number of objects for each country in 2023
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

entities_2023 <- outer_space_objects %>%
  filter(Year == 2023)

print(entities_2023)



# Print the summary table of top 5 country in 2023
library(dplyr)
entities_2023 <- entities_2023 %>%
  filter(Entity != "World")

top_5 <- entities_2023 %>%
  top_n(5, num_objects) %>%
  arrange(desc(num_objects))

print(top_5)


column_colors <- c("skyblue", "orange", "green", "red", "purple")  # Add or change colors as needed

# Create ggplot2
ggplot(top_5, aes(x = reorder(Entity, num_objects), y = num_objects, fill = Entity)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  geom_text(aes(label = num_objects), vjust = -0.5, size = 3.5, color = "black") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = column_colors) +  # Set custom column colors
  labs(title = "Top 5 Country with the most objects in 2023",
       x = "Country",
       y = "Number of objects") +
  theme_minimal()
